summary: Operator site (home, campsites, about, contact), RV Life reviews, Google and imagery read. Site unchanged: 60 electric RV sites of 85, showers and pool, no rates, Book Now still goes to the contact page (phone booking stays). Price only from a 2023 camper report ($35) and the RV Life $$ tier. Riverview kept: rigs on the SW lane sit ~20 m from a ~20-25 m-wide Kickapoo behind a sparse brush line, no site numbers to place.
flags: PRICE (private): no rate on the operator site and no booking engine (BOOK NOW links to the contact page). Camper report: $35 a night for a motorhome on a power + water back-in (site 13, RV Life, 7/2023); RV Life tier $$ (avg $24). Likely under $50; not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km. Presence passes: working website with phone 608-735-4929; Google 4.5 (54); RV Life 4* over 3 reviews.

LONG-STAY: the website markets nightly camping, a pool and events (the Stump Dodger Bash festival, weddings) and says nothing about seasonal sites; no long-stay wording found. Imagery (leaf-out spring frame) shows 40+ rigs parked across both loops, which may include seasonals, but the share could not be measured (no site list, no engine). Not read as long-stay in character, so no test-2 failure.

WATERFRONT: riverview kept. Imagery: the campground fills the strip between the Crawford County fairgrounds and the Kickapoo River; the west lane's rigs (about 43.3116,-90.8495 to 43.3108,-90.8500) sit ~15-25 m from the water behind a sparse brush and tree line, and the southern rigs behind denser trees. The channel there is ~20-25 m wide, so an on-water value would be creekside at most, and no published site map names the riverside sites. Lead only: if a site map turns up, the westmost riverside spurs could be creekside.
PIN 43.3126,-90.8475 is on the ball field east of the north loop, ~150 m from the riverside rigs; campground centroid about 43.3115,-90.8487 (Google's point). Under 250 m: fine.
WEBSITE https://www.ksdcampground.com/ and PHONE 608-735-4929 confirmed (the site also lists a 'Toll Free: 608-632-1162').
